release_notes:
v1.0.7+7 - Complete Central Mind Relational Correlation & Financial Ledger Sync
- Resolved student-teacher relational mapping across Faculty, Students, Courses, and Timetable
- Course creation & editing now persist instructor_id FK and synchronize syllabus modules to public.lessons
- Walk-in admissions and manual payments synchronize across both mpesa_transactions and enrollments
- Timetable booking resolves real teacher/student UUIDs, time slots, and kmc_studio_X WebRTC room slugs
- Time pass granting, editing, extending (+60 min), and revoking persist directly to Supabase
